title: Tab bar
summary: The app's root after account-start: the tab bar Conversas · Grupos · Você plus search (ADR 0053). A company account has Conversas · Trabalho · Você plus search: Trabalho takes the place of Grupos, and Conversas holds its groups too. The Você tab is the only account switcher: a double tap switches to the next account, a long press opens account-switcher (ADR 0135).

userId.description: Matrix ID. Never shown to the user.

handle.description: The @handle from bipe-api, when the account has one.

avatarUrl.description: mxc URL of the account's avatar.

isCurrent.description: true for the account the app shows now.

hasUnread.description: true when the account has unread messages; drives the other-account dot (ADR 0135).

isCompany.description: True only when GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type or the authenticated account status says company (ADR 0132). Company avatars are rounded squares; personal and unknown accounts are circles.

ownerName.description: For a company account made on this phone: the display name of its owner, the personal account that was on screen at chooseCompany of account-new (bipe-chat/bipe#444). Absent when the owner is not on this phone.

selectedTab.description: The visible tab. search is a tab on iOS (search tab role) and a top-bar action on Android (ADR 0053). trabalho shows only for a company account, in place of grupos (business-tools).

accounts.description: Every account on this phone, in the order they were added (oldest first).

conversasUnread.description: Unread DMs and Pedidos for the Conversas badge. For a company account the badge adds gruposAttention, because its groups are in Conversas.

gruposAttention.description: Mentions, replies and new polls in groups (ADR 0053). Quiet groups count only these.

otherAccountUnread.description: true when an account other than the current one has unread messages: a dot on the Você tab icon (ADR 0135).

selectTab.effect: Shows that tab. A tap on Você always opens Você.

doubleTapVoce.effect: Switches to the next account in accounts (wraps around) and plays the switch haptic (ADR 0134). With one account it does the same as a tap.

longPressVoce.effect: Opens account-switcher in place, anchored on the Você tab (MZ decision 25 Oct 2026).

switchAccount.effect: Makes that account current: its sync runs in front, the tabs show its chats, and the choice is saved for the next start (account-start).

notes: MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): Buscar is the last tab, apart from Conversas, Grupos (Agenda) and Você. iOS uses the system search tab role (Tab(role: .search)); iOS 26 and later draw it apart at the trailing end of the tab bar. Android keeps the Material idiom: the bottom bar has only the main destinations and search is the trailing action of the top bar of Conversas and Grupos.

MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): a long press (hold) on the Você tab opens account-switcher in place, as the native menu anchored on the tab (iOS context menu, Android dropdown menu). The tab bar of iOS 26 and later has its own press-and-drag gesture: the long press must still open the menu.
Conversas holds DMs (rooms with two members) and the Pedidos row; Grupos holds rooms with more than two members (ADR 0053). chat-list renders both with its scope.
Each account has its own SDK client and session store, keyed by user ID (ADR 0086). Only the current account's sync runs in front; the others sync in the background for the badge and the dot.
The tab bar shows the same on iPhone and as a rail on iPad (ADR 0135 point 6).

Company account: Trabalho (bipe_tab_work) replaces Grupos in the same place, and there is no separate Agenda tab (agenda-owner opens from Trabalho). Trabalho shows business-tools; each tool opens its owner screen inside the tab. Conversas shows DMs and groups together, with the group invites under the Pedidos row, and a notification for a group opens Conversas. On Android, search is the trailing action of the Conversas top bar only. When the current account changes from company to personal on Trabalho, or from personal to company on Grupos, Conversas shows.
Status comes later and is not in this spec.
